name: pxd2-hugs-agent
rule: The token is the compression system. Encode a phrase to PXD2T1. Decrypt the number with the mounted book. No bearer string.
steps: present PXD2T1 token (encode PHRASE against the book)
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 after snapshot is on disk
write: Pages is read. Drop a PXD2T1 token via git commit hold/ftp.
